purpose: Source map for truthful public explanations of Mythical Void's genetics, browser engine, and AI media layer.

claims.claim: Creature genetics combine species, appearance, personality, rarity, and cosmic affinity.
claims.limits: Do not claim infinite uniqueness or consciousness.

claims.claim: Phaser 3 runs the playable browser world.
claims.limits: Do not imply every feature works offline or that Phaser itself is an AI system.

claims.claim: After an age range is selected, experimental services can create private AI-made media from fictional creature information for every age band in the current release.
claims.limits: State that the selected age range and player information are not sent to the model. Do not claim unrestricted generation, child profiling, child safety, zero risk, or that generated media replaces authored story content. Keep Cloud Save and friend-linking restrictions separate.

claims.claim: The game can show selected NASA public space content and space-weather signals as optional learning moments.
claims.limits: Do not imply NASA endorses Mythical Void, that the game is an official NASA product, or that live data is guaranteed to be available.

approval.nextReviewTrigger: Relevant source, safety boundary, provider, or public wording changes
